cause.behavior: Client filter input left old rows selectable until its 300ms timer applied the local filter and unconditionally cleared selections, including selections made after typing.
cause.result: check succeeded; later unchecked row and absent preview toolbar caused 30s click timeout

fix: Apply local filter and reset previous selection, expansion and page in the input change handler. Debounce URL persistence only.

cases: Prior bulk selection clears immediately when filtering, including disappearance of nonmatching rows
New filtered selection survives 300ms URL persistence and previews exactly both selected obligations; initial URL filter and unrelated query/hash retained

typecheck.scope: No-emit overlay extends server/tsconfig.json, includes AutomaticInvoices.tsx and its transitive imports, incremental false

limitations: One successful native browser rerun does not establish repeatability.
No browser assertions, retry counts or timeouts were weakened.
Existing URL behavior initializes from location and persists edits; this fix does not introduce history popstate synchronization.
